title: Comply with the national higher education code on gender-based violence
what: Higher education providers must comply with the national code to prevent and respond to gender-based violence.

laws.title: Universities Accord (National Higher Education Code to Prevent and Respond to Gender-based Violence) Act 2025

sources.title: Universities Accord (National Higher Education Code to Prevent and Respond to Gender-based Violence) Act 2025
sources.quote: 20 Provider must comply with the national code A higher education provider is liable to a civil penalty if: (a) the provider is subject to a requirement under the national code; and (b) the provider fails to comply with the requirement.
